decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core physical-music catalog in a growing retail market, the schlager compilation CD does not show a clear performance shortfall relative to aspiration levels and can be retained while the firm continues broadening genres.

Because the illustrated music release series builds directly on the firm's established curation and label capabilities and there is no visible sign of underperformance, boundedly rational management would use available slack to continue it and learn from the market.
